text:
Type: distressed handtufted area rug
Use: accenting a floor area; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: farmhouse, rustic, contemporary
Materials: handtufted cotton and wool, distressed texture
Colors: cream, warm gold
Shape: rectangular, abstract distressed grid pattern, low soft pile, compact
Feel: warm, light, organic
Goes with: natural wood, brick or terracotta floors, white walls, green plants; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Distressed Handtufted Cotton and Wool Area Rug 4' x 6', Gold and Cream
product.description: The distressed look of this cotton-and-wool handtufted rug will add a modern accent to your space, but the warm gold and cream coloring is flexible enough to work with any decor. A semiplush pile will soften and brighten bare areas while bringing warmth and comfort. 4'W x 6'L 80% wool, 20% cotton Handtufted with a distressed pattern A medium pile of 0.4" suits any indoor space. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
